raw_text: Analysis: The AIIMS Delhi ransomware incident exposes critical gaps in India's healthcare cybersecurity posture. Our investigation reveals that AIIMS was running Windows Server 2008 on several key systems — an OS that reached end-of-life in January 2020. The hospital's IT infrastructure lacked proper network segmentation, allowing the ransomware to propagate from administrative systems to clinical databases. Healthcare institutions in India spend less than 2% of their IT budget on cybersecurity, compared to 6-8% globally. This attack should serve as a wake-up call for the entire Indian public health system.
